summary: Iter 19 backend-only sweep — 30 pytest cases against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL covering OTP signup, founder 2x multiplier, anti-abuse referrals, stokvel purpose, product type/currency/availability, birth_month validation, score & referral-code parity. Result: 27 PASS, 2 SKIPPED (Stokvel create gated by activation-fee insufficient wallet — not testable via public API), 1 FAILED exposing a real schema bug: /api/users/me Pydantic User response model strips email_verified, is_founder, founder_signup_rank, founder_multiplier_until from the payload (verify-otp itself works — verified independently because the founder-window 2x test relies on email_verified=true to pass the complete-profile gate, and it succeeded with score=500=250x2). Confirmed working: progressive-signup creates email_verified=false + founder block (rank/until populated for first-1000), referral_code is uppercase and equals user.id[:8].upper(); /founders/status public payload (limit=1000, multiplier=2, duration_days=30, claimed/available/active correct); send-otp returns 6-digit _mock_code with ttl_minutes=10; 30s cooldown returns 429 on rapid resend; verify-otp accepts correct code and rejects wrong with 400; 6 wrong attempts returns 429 (max-attempts); complete-profile returns 403 when email_verified=false and 200 after verify; birth_month validation rejects 0 and 13 with 400 on both POST /auth/complete-profile and PUT /api/users/me; referrals/capture rejects self-referral 400, unknown ref 404, idempotent on second call (already_attributed=true); referral reward fires +200 (or 400 if referrer is founder/premium) ONLY after invitee verifies email AND completes profile, and is idempotent (no duplicate event); founder 2x multiplier verified end-to-end via fresh signup → complete-profile awarded exactly 500 points (250 base x 2), score/summary returned premium_multiplier_active=true and founder_multiplier.{active=true,is_founder=true,rank>=1,until populated}; score parity holds (users.me.network_score == score/summary.lifetime_score); product create currency auto-defaults: south_africa→ZAR, nigeria→NGN, kenya→KES, ghana→GHS, uganda→USD; currency override accepted; type=service + availability=preorder persisted; availability=available_in_days persists availability_days=14.

minor.issue: Pydantic User response_model is missing email_verified, is_founder, founder_signup_rank, founder_multiplier_until fields — they exist on the DB document and on /auth/progressive-signup response, but get stripped here. Frontend that renders the founder badge or email-verified state from /users/me will see those fields as undefined. Fix: add the four fields to class User(BaseModel) at /app/backend/server.py lines 92-123. Also add email_verified_at if needed for badges.

action_items: Add missing fields to User Pydantic model in /app/backend/server.py (class User around line 92): email_verified: Optional[bool] = False, is_founder: Optional[bool] = False, founder_signup_rank: Optional[int] = None, founder_multiplier_until: Optional[str] = None. Without this the founder badge & verification chip on Profile/Header reads them as undefined.

Stokvel /api/stokvels create cannot be exercised by a fresh test user because STOKVEL_CREATOR_FEE check happens before purpose validation and there is no public deposit endpoint for new users to fund their wallet. Two tests skipped. Recommend either (a) adding a /api/dev/seed-wallet endpoint for tests, or (b) reorder so purpose normalization is unit-testable, or (c) accept the existing code review (purpose normalization at server.py 2872-2876 is straightforward — ALLOWED_PURPOSES set includes savings/holiday/event/gift/group_trip/wedding/funeral/other; invalid → savings; persisted to stokvel_data['purpose']).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py User response model (lines 92-123) is OUT OF DATE with the document schema written by /auth/progressive-signup (lines 4327-4357). Any new field added to user_data is invisible on /users/me unless mirrored on User. This has bitten this iteration with email_verified + 3 founder fields. Suggest centralising or using a dict-passthrough response.

server.py /referrals/capture (line 4525): the $or query allows a username match, but referral_code is uppercase whereas usernames are lowercase — case sensitivity is fine here, but documenting that ref param accepts either canonical referral_code (recommended) or username is worth noting in API docs.

server.py /auth/complete-profile (line 4679): the 'profile_completed' bonus uses base_points=0 and relies on the SCORE_TABLE lookup inside award_points to substitute 250. This works but is non-obvious — consider passing 250 explicitly for readability.
server.py /products POST (line 3851) silently overwrites unsupported currency back to auto_currency (line 3866) instead of 400ing — debatable UX. Acceptable if intentional.

server.py /auth/send-otp creates a NEW otp record on every call with no cleanup of previous unused ones — fine functionally (verify picks the latest) but db.otps will grow unboundedly. Add a TTL index on expires_at or sweep on insert.

server.py /auth/verify-otp (line 4490): max-attempts is checked BEFORE the wrong-code path, so the 5-attempt counter only blocks a 6th attempt. Spec says 'max 5 attempts'; current code allows exactly 5 wrong, then 429 on the 6th. Pragma: matches typical UX (5 tries → locked). Worth confirming with PM intent.
server.py LIFETIME_SCORE_CAP clamp at line 644 correctly caps the multiplier output, and the founder window flag check at lines 633-642 honours the until-date — looks correct.

server.py /referrals/capture allows already_attributed idempotent return (line 4522) but returns it ONLY when current user already has referred_by set — does not re-validate referrer match; acceptable since first capture wins.

rca_of_the_issue: /api/users/me does not surface email_verified or any founder field even though /auth/progressive-signup writes them and /auth/verify-otp updates email_verified=true. Reproduction: signup → send-otp → verify-otp (returns {verified:true}) → GET /api/users/me → response missing email_verified, is_founder, founder_signup_rank, founder_multiplier_until. RCA: server.py line 781 declares `@api_router.get('/users/me', response_model=User)` which causes FastAPI to filter the dict through the User Pydantic schema (lines 92-123) — that schema lacks the four fields. The DB document HAS them (verified by reading user from /auth/progressive-signup which uses no response_model). Mitigation (4 lines added to class User): `email_verified: Optional[bool] = False`, `is_founder: Optional[bool] = False`, `founder_signup_rank: Optional[int] = None`, `founder_multiplier_until: Optional[str] = None`. After fix the failing test will pass and the frontend founder badge / verification chip on Profile/Header will render correctly.
